title: Data Pipeline Refactor
summary: Refactored legacy data pipeline so project could move forward again.
details: For a customer who was stuck I paid back technical debt so he could move forward. It was a fragile data pipeline—buggy and hard to maintain. To fix this I: Fixed underlying safety issues by creating a shared base stage that safely handled errors. Ensured consistency by unifying code that performed same functions but had multiple implementations. Added integration-level test coverage into CI/CD. Created tools  to simplify the dev environment.
